description: GII GeM ERP - Government e-Marketplace Enterprise Resource Planning Workflow Repository

workflows.name: Supply Order to Closure
workflows.purpose: End-to-end lifecycle management of a government supply order from creation through fulfillment, invoicing, payment, and final closure with full audit trail for GeM compliance.

steps.name: Supply Order Creation
steps.description: Create supply order against a GeM contract with item details, quantities, delivery schedule, and terms.
validationRules: Contract reference must be active and valid
Order value must not exceed allocated budget
All mandatory fields must be filled
GST and TDS applicability must be determined
Delivery location must be a valid government entity

steps.name: Stock Reservation
steps.description: Reserve required stock from available inventory based on supply order items to ensure availability.
validationRules: Sufficient stock must be available for reservation
Reservation must be against specific batch/lot where applicable
Expiry date check for consumable items

steps.name: Procurement Initiation
steps.description: Initiate procurement process if reserved stock is insufficient; create purchase requisition for shortfall.
validationRules: Procurement must follow GeM marketplace or L1 bidding
Value above threshold requires tender committee approval
Make or buy decision must be documented

steps.name: Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
steps.description: Receive goods against supply order or purchase order; inspect quantity, quality, and condition.
validationRules: GRN must reference valid PO or SO
Received quantity must not exceed ordered quantity unless allowed
Quality inspection must pass for all items
Photographic evidence for high-value items
DRP (Defect Reporting Period) must be noted

steps.name: Stock Receipt & Inward
steps.description: Update inventory system with received stock; assign bin location, batch number, and update stock ledger.
validationRules: GRN must be approved before stock receipt
Stock must be physically verified before system entry
Batch and serial number capture for trackable items
Location assignment must follow warehouse zoning

steps.name: Delivery Challan Generation
steps.description: Generate delivery challan for dispatch of goods to the consignee location as per supply order.
validationRules: Delivery challan must reference supply order
Transport mode must be specified
Insurance details for high-value consignments
E-way bill generation if applicable

steps.name: Stock Issue / Dispatch
steps.description: Physically issue stock from warehouse and update inventory records for dispatched quantities.
validationRules: Delivery challan must be printed and signed
Stock must be issued against reserved inventory
FIFO/FEFO method must be followed for issue
Gate pass must be generated for physical movement

steps.name: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Recognition
steps.description: Calculate and record COGS based on actual cost of inventory issued; match against valuation method.
validationRules: Cost valuation method must be consistent (FIFO/Weighted Average)
All associated costs must be included (purchase cost, freight, insurance)
COGS must match inventory valuation report

steps.name: Billing / Invoice Generation
steps.description: Generate invoice against delivered supply order with applicable taxes, deductions, and payment terms.
validationRules: Invoice must reference supply order and delivery challan
GST calculation must match applicable rate
TDS deduction as per applicable section
Invoice value must match order value less deductions
Digital signature required for e-invoice

steps.name: Receivable Recognition
steps.description: Record invoice as receivable in the financial system; update customer ledger and aging report.
validationRules: Invoice must be posted before receivable recognition
Receivable must match invoice value
Due date must be calculated as per payment terms

steps.name: Payment Collection
steps.description: Track and reconcile incoming payments from government department against invoices.
validationRules: Payment must be matched against specific invoice(s)
Partial payments must be properly allocated
Payment reference (PFMS/CPPP) must be captured

steps.name: Profitability Analysis
steps.description: Compute profit margin for the order by comparing revenue against COGS and other direct costs.
validationRules: All costs must be fully captured before profitability calculation
Overhead allocation must follow policy
Margin must be within approved thresholds

steps.name: Order Closure
steps.description: Final closure of supply order after all deliverables, payments, and compliance checks are complete.
validationRules: All items must be delivered and accepted
Full payment must be received
No pending claims or disputes
All documents must be archived
Contract closure must be updated on GeM portal

commonMistakes: GRN created before physical inspection of goods
Invoice generated without proper delivery challan reference
TDS not deducted at applicable rate leading to penalties
Stock issued from wrong batch/lot violating FIFO
Order closure initiated before full payment reconciliation
businessRules: Supply order cannot exceed allocated budget without re-approval
All high-value orders (>₹25L) require two-tier approval
GRN must be completed within 48 hours of physical receipt
Invoice must be raised within 7 days of delivery confirmation
Order closure requires all linked documents to be in 'Approved' status

workflows.name: Procurement to Payment
workflows.purpose: Manage the complete procurement cycle from purchase requisition through supplier payment and financial closure for government supplies.

steps.name: Procurement / Purchase Order
steps.description: Create purchase order against approved requisition; select supplier via GeM or L1 process.
validationRules: PO must reference valid PR
Supplier must be GeM registered
PO value must be within approved procurement budget
Terms and conditions must align with GeM contract
Delivery schedule must be realistic and agreed

steps.name: Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
steps.description: Receive and inspect goods against purchase order; record quantity, quality, and document discrepancies.
validationRules: GRN must link to valid PO
Quantity received must be physically counted
Quality inspection certificate must be attached
Rejected items must be documented with reason
DRP start date must be recorded

steps.name: Stock Receipt / Inventory Update
steps.description: Update inventory system with received stock quantities, values, and bin location details.
validationRules: GRN must be approved before stock entry
Valuation must match PO rate
Batch/serial numbers captured for tracked items

steps.name: Payable Recognition
steps.description: Record supplier payable based on GRN; capture liability in financial system.
validationRules: GRN must be fully approved
Payable amount must equal received quantity × PO rate
GST input credit eligibility must be determined
TDS must be computed and deducted

steps.name: Supplier Payment Processing
steps.description: Process payment to supplier as per agreed terms; generate payment advice and release funds.
validationRules: Payment must be within due date to avoid interest
3-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) must be completed
Bank details must be verified against vendor master
Payment approval within delegated authority limits

steps.name: Payment Allocation & Reconciliation
steps.description: Allocate payment to outstanding invoices; update vendor ledger and clear aging entries.
validationRules: Payment must be fully allocated against open items
Partial payments must follow allocation rules (oldest first)
Discount or penalty adjustments must be documented

steps.name: Procurement Cycle Closure
steps.description: Close procurement cycle after all payments, reconciliations, and compliance documentation are complete.
validationRules: All POs linked to the cycle must be fully delivered
All invoices must be paid
Vendor balance must be zero or reconciled
All documents must be archived per retention policy

commonMistakes: GRN created before physical verification of goods
Payable recorded without proper TDS computation
Payment processed without 3-way match validation
Allocation of payments to wrong invoices
Procurement closure before all linked documents are finalized
businessRules: All procurements above ₹5L must go through GeM marketplace
GRN must be processed within 1 working day of receipt
Payment must be processed within 30 days of invoice receipt
3-way match is mandatory before any payment release
TDS must be deducted at source as per applicable section

workflows.name: Billing to Collection
workflows.purpose: Manage the complete billing lifecycle from invoice generation through payment collection, receipt allocation, and statutory deduction compliance.

steps.name: Invoice / Billing
steps.description: Generate tax invoice for delivered goods/services with correct HSN/SAC, GST, and other statutory details.
validationRules: Invoice must reference valid supply order and delivery challan
HSN/SAC code must be correctly applied
GST rate must match product/service classification
Invoice value must not exceed order value
E-invoice JSON must be generated for B2G transactions

steps.name: Receivable Booking
steps.description: Book invoice as trade receivable in financial system with proper debtor identification and aging classification.
validationRules: Invoice must be in 'Posted' status
Customer must be correctly identified in master data
Receivable amount must equal invoice total
Due date must be computed per payment terms

steps.name: Payment Receipt
steps.description: Receive and record incoming payment from government department via PFMS, RTGS, NEFT, or cheque.
validationRules: Payment reference (PFMS/UTR) must be captured
Amount must match expected or be accepted as partial
Payment mode must be recorded correctly
Cheque must be deposited on same day for clearance tracking

steps.name: Receipt Allocation
steps.description: Allocate received payment against outstanding invoices; handle partial, on-account, and advance payments.
validationRules: Receipt must be cleared in bank before allocation
Allocation must match receipt amount (or leave balance as on-account)
Oldest invoice must be cleared first per policy
Discount or write-off must be approved

steps.name: TDS / GST TDS Deduction
steps.description: Record TDS deducted by government department on payment; claim credit in GST returns and income tax.
validationRules: TDS certificate must be obtained from deductor
TDS rate must match applicable section (e.g., 194Q, 194C)
GST TDS must be claimed in GSTR-7
Income Tax TDS must be claimed in Form 26AS

steps.name: Billing-to-Collection Closure
steps.description: Close the billing cycle after full collection, allocation, and statutory compliance for the invoice.
validationRules: Invoice must be fully paid
All TDS credits must be claimed
No disputes or claims pending
All documents must be archived

commonMistakes: Incorrect GST rate applied leading to mismatch in returns
E-invoice schema validation errors not caught before generation
Receipt allocated to wrong invoice causing aging distortion
TDS credit not tracked properly leading to cash leakage
Partial payments not allocated correctly leaving residuals
businessRules: Invoice must be raised within 7 days of delivery confirmation
Credit period for government departments is 30-45 days as per GeM terms
All payments above ₹1L must be through banking channels only
TDS must be tracked at invoice level for accurate credit claiming
Overdue invoices (>90 days) must be escalated to management

workflows.name: Bank Reconciliation
workflows.purpose: Reconcile bank statements with book entries to ensure accuracy of cash and bank balances, identify discrepancies, and post corrective vouchers.

steps.name: Bank Statement Import
steps.description: Import bank statement from bank portal (auto-API or manual Excel/PDF upload) into reconciliation system.
validationRules: Statement must be in supported format (BAI2, CSV, PDF)
Opening balance must match previous closing balance
All transactions within the statement period must be included
Statement must be authenticated (digital signature or verified source)

steps.name: Duplicate & Anomaly Check
steps.description: Scan imported transactions for duplicates, missing entries, or anomalies before proceeding to matching.
validationRules: Duplicate transaction detection based on UTR/cheque number + amount + date
Missing sequential cheque number alert
Negative balance or unusual large transactions flagged
Date range validity check

steps.name: Transaction Matching
steps.description: Match bank statement lines with book entries using auto-matching rules and manual intervention for exceptions.
validationRules: Auto-matching on UTR, cheque number, amount, and date proximity
Partial matching allowed for consolidated payments
Unmatched items must be investigated within TAT
Match confidence score must exceed threshold (80%)

steps.name: Journal Voucher Proposal
steps.description: Propose journal vouchers for unmatched differences such as bank charges, interest, errors, or missing entries.
validationRules: Each difference must have a documented reason
Bank charges must be under authorized limits
Interest entries must be verified against bank rate
Suspense entries require additional approval

steps.name: Manager Approval
steps.description: Review proposed vouchers and reconciliation adjustments by manager before final posting.
validationRules: All proposed entries must have supporting evidence
Material differences must be explained
Suspense account entries need written justification

steps.name: Final Posting & Reconciliation Closure
steps.description: Post approved vouchers and finalize reconciliation for the period; update bank ledger balance.
validationRules: All approved vouchers must be posted
Closing balance must match bank statement ending balance
Reconciliation summary must be printed and archived

commonMistakes: Duplicate entries not detected leading to double counting
Unmatched items carried forward without investigation
Bank charges booked without verifying actual charge
Suspense entries not cleared within the month
Final reconciliation posted before all bank entries are captured
businessRules: Bank reconciliation must be completed within 7 days of month end
Unmatched items older than 30 days must be escalated
Suspense account must be zero at month end
All bank charges must be verified against bank schedule
Auto-matching confidence threshold is 80%; below requires manual review

workflows.name: Year-End Closing
workflows.purpose: Execute the annual financial closing process including trial balance review, outstanding clearance, financial year lock, closing entries, and balance carry forward for government audit readiness.
prerequisites: Bank reconciliations done for all months

steps.name: Trial Balance Review
steps.description: Review annual trial balance for anomalies, unusual balances, or missing entries before proceeding to closing.
validationRules: Trial balance must balance (debits = credits)
All control accounts must be reconciled (AP, AR, Inventory)
Suspense accounts must be zero
Inter-branch accounts must match
Budget vs actual variance must be analyzed

steps.name: Posting Queue Clearance
steps.description: Clear any pending posting queues including stock transactions, invoices, and pending journal entries.
validationRules: No pending stock transactions in queue
All invoices must be posted
All journal entries in draft must be finalized or deleted
Recurring entries must be posted for the period

steps.name: Approval Queue Clearance
steps.description: Ensure all pending approvals (POs, invoices, payments, vouchers) are resolved before year-end lock.
validationRules: No PO pending approval beyond authority
All invoices must be in approved or rejected state
Payment proposals must be resolved
Employee reimbursement claims must be cleared

steps.name: Financial Year Lock
steps.description: Lock the financial year to prevent any new transactions or modifications to historical data.
validationRules: All prior period entries must be finalized
No open periods in sub-ledgers (Inventory, AP, AR)
Backup must be taken before lock
Audit trail must be enabled before lock
Lock must be authorized by CFO or equivalent

steps.name: Closing Entries Posting
steps.description: Post year-end closing entries including P&L transfer to retained earnings, provisions, and adjustments.
validationRules: All closing entries must have documentary evidence
P&L balance must be transferred to retained earnings
Provisions must be booked as per policy
Deferred tax assets/liabilities must be computed
Closing entries must be approved by CFO

steps.name: Carry Forward Balances
steps.description: Carry forward closing balances of balance sheet accounts to the new financial year as opening balances.
validationRules: All balance sheet accounts must carry forward
Opening balances must equal previous year closing balances
New year budget must be loaded (if applicable)
Statutory registers must be updated for new year

commonMistakes: Year lock applied before all pending transactions are cleared
Closing entries not approved by appropriate authority
Inter-branch accounts not reconciled before carry forward
Deferred tax computation errors
Carry forward balances differing from audited closing figures
businessRules: Year-end closing must be completed within 45 days of financial year end
No transactions can be posted to a locked year without special admin authority
All closing entries must be approved by Finance Controller and CFO
System backup must be taken before and after year-end lock
Audit trail must be enabled and verified before closure

workflows.name: Stock Lifecycle
workflows.purpose: Manage the complete lifecycle of inventory from procurement requirement identification through procurement, receipt, storage, reservation, issue, and cost recognition for government supplies.

steps.name: Procurement Requirement Identification
steps.description: Identify stock requirements based on reorder levels, demand forecasting, or specific supply orders.
validationRules: Requirement must consider current stock levels and committed orders
Lead time must be factored into requirement date
Minimum order quantity (MOQ) must be respected
Budget allocation must exist for the procurement

steps.name: Procurement Execution
steps.description: Execute procurement through GeM marketplace or approved procurement process to fulfill stock requirements.
validationRules: Procurement must follow GeM or tendering rules
Supplier must be GeM empaneled or approved
Rate must be within approved price list or L1

steps.name: Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
steps.description: Receive and inspect incoming stock against purchase order with quality verification.
validationRules: GRN must reference valid PO
Physical count must match received quantity
Quality inspection must pass for acceptance

steps.name: Stock Inward / Putaway
steps.description: Move accepted stock to designated bin locations and update inventory records with accurate quantities and values.
validationRules: GRN must be approved before inward movement
Bin location must follow ABC classification
Batch/serial numbers must be recorded
Stock valuation must match PO rate

steps.name: Stock Reservation / Allocation
steps.description: Reserve stock against supply orders or internal requisitions to ensure availability at time of issue.
validationRules: Reservation against specific supply order/requisition
FIFO batch selection for perishable/dated items
Reservation must not exceed available quantity
Expiry date validation for consumables

steps.name: Stock Outward / Issue
steps.description: Physically pick and issue stock from warehouse against delivery challan or material requisition.
validationRules: Pick list must match delivery challan items
Reserved stock must be picked first
FIFO/FEFO must be followed for issue
Gate pass must be generated for outward movement

steps.name: Delivery Challan
steps.description: Generate and manage delivery challan for dispatched stock with transportation and recipient details.
validationRules: Delivery challan must reference issue voucher
Transport details must be complete
E-way bill generated if required

steps.name: COGS Recognition
steps.description: Recognize cost of goods sold based on valuation method (FIFO/Weighted Average) for issued stock.
validationRules: Cost valuation method must be consistently applied
All issue-related costs must be included
COGS must reconcile with inventory movement report

commonMistakes: GRN processed without physical inspection of goods
Stock inward to wrong bin location causing picking errors
FIFO not followed for batch-managed items
COGS recognized before stock issue is physically confirmed
Delivery challan generated without stock issue voucher reference
businessRules: All inward stock must be GRNed within 24 hours of receipt
Stock valuation method cannot be changed mid-year without approval
Reservation must be released if not consumed within 15 days
Obsolete stock (>2 years) must be identified and provisioned
Physical stock count must be done quarterly and reconciled
